children: Longevity Health Holdings secured financing through a 10% Senior Secured Convertible Note with $416,667 in original principal for $375,000 in proceeds and the potential for up to two additional notes of $138,889 each, subject to conditions. The note, due February 29, 2028, carries monthly cash interest and conversion at $0.50 per share or 80% of the 5-day average if lower, with ownership caps. To secure the debt, the company and its subsidiaries granted first-priority liens on substantially all assets, including intellectual property, and provided subsidiary guarantees, with an affidavit of confession of judgment available to the lender upon default. Proceeds will support working capital within existing settlement constraints.
